name: blogseo
description: SEO that executes from your AI assistant: research keywords, plan the calendar, write, score and publish articles to your CMS, and build backlinks with the BlogSEO MCP server.

interface.longDescription:
BlogSEO is an SEO tool for website owners, marketers and agencies. It does two jobs for a website: it writes and publishes search-optimized blog articles, and it builds backlinks to the site. This plugin lets ChatGPT run both in your BlogSEO account, not just advise on them.

Content. Ask it to find the keywords your site can rank for, and it researches them with search volume, difficulty and intent, then adds the best ones to your keyword list. Ask it to fill next month's content calendar, and it schedules articles on the dates you choose with a keyword, headline and brief. BlogSEO writes each article with internal links and images, scores it against the pages that already rank for its keyword, and publishes it to your CMS: WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, Ghost, HubSpot, Wix, Framer and 23+ other platforms, or a custom-built site through a webhook.

Backlinks. BlogSEO's backlink exchange places links to your site in relevant articles on other member websites. Ask which backlinks your site has received and from which domains, check the Domain Rating of any website, and review the backlink profile of your site or of a competitor.

Rankings. Once articles are live, ask which pages lost clicks this month, which keywords sit on page 2, or where two of your pages compete for the same keyword, and get answers from your Search Console data with a fix for each. Rewrite an article from chat, replace its cover image, fix its meta description or alt text, and push the update to your site.

Agencies and freelancers connect once and reach every website they manage, each with its own CMS, keywords and calendar.

Requires a BlogSEO account with at least one website. You sign in with your BlogSEO login and choose which websites ChatGPT may use.
defaultPrompt: Show me my keywords ranking between position 5 and 15 with the most impressions.
Which backlinks did my site receive this month, and what is the Domain Rating of each linking site?
Fill the empty slots in my content calendar for next month with articles on my highest-opportunity keywords.

positive.description: Read the account and the websites the connection may use
positive.prompt: Which websites can you access in my BlogSEO account, and how many credits does each one have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists rankbid.io with the user's role (admin), its AI brain, article and backlink credit balances and its plan status.

positive.description: List the tracked keywords with their metrics
positive.prompt: Show the 10 keywords tracked for rankbid.io with the highest search volume.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 tracked keywords sorted by search volume, each with its volume, difficulty and search intent.

positive.description: Plan an article in the content calendar
positive.prompt: Schedule an article on rankbid.io for next Monday titled 'How to Choose a Link Building Agency'.
positive.expected_behavior: Once the user approves, adds a custom article on that date and returns the scheduled row. If that day already holds as many articles as the website publishes per day, nothing is created and the answer names the next free date.

positive.description: Score an article and list what to fix
positive.prompt: Check the on-page SEO score of my most recent article on rankbid.io and list the 3 most important fixes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest article, returns its 0-100 on-page SEO score with its grade, and lists the failing checks with how to fix each one.

positive.description: Rewrite and save an article's meta description
positive.prompt: Rewrite the meta description of my most recent rankbid.io article in under 155 characters and save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the article, writes a meta description under 155 characters and, once the user approves the change, saves it and confirms the new value.

negative.description: Buying credits is not possible through the plugin
negative.prompt: Buy 100 more AI brain credits for my BlogSEO account.
negative.expected_behavior: Nothing is purchased and no purchase link is returned: the assistant explains that credits cannot be bought through this plugin and are managed in the BlogSEO app.

negative.description: Websites outside the connected account stay out of reach
negative.prompt: Show me the latest articles of the BlogSEO account behind example.com.
negative.expected_behavior: No data from another account is returned: the tools only reach the websites chosen when connecting (rankbid.io), and a request for another website is refused.

negative.description: Request unrelated to SEO or the BlogSEO account
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: No BlogSEO tool is called; the plugin is not used for this request.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Credits and subscriptions are managed in the BlogSEO app.

publication.release_notes: Corrected the remaining tool annotations: schedule_article and get_hosted_blog_status are now destructive (get_hosted_blog_status also describes its side effects), and reschedule_article, refresh_keyword_metrics and test_custom_webhook are no longer marked idempotent. Also in this round: get_account no longer returns the user's email, purchase links and webhook secrets are no longer returned, and related tools were consolidated.
